pages.en:
The Gandr Shot Tohsaka mentioned belongs, I think, to Scandinavian rune magecraft: an indirect curse that worsens the target’s physical condition when the practitioner points at them.

It is only supposed to make someone ill. Under no circumstances should it produce such immediate, explosive results.

Its effect is to worsen someone’s illness, so it shouldn’t be something with any physical effect.
